problems.description: The requirement does not specify what happens if the user enters an invalid email.
The requirement does not specify what happens if the user enters an invalid password.
The requirement does not specify what happens after the user deletes their account.
The requirement does not specify what happens if the user clicks the "go elsewhere" link while not signed in.

questions.question: What should happen if a registered user tries to sign in with an invalid email?
What should happen if a registered user tries to sign in with an invalid password?
What should happen after a signed-in user deletes their account?
What should happen if the user clicks the "go elsewhere" link while not signed in?

recommendations.text: Clarify the expected behavior for invalid email and password scenarios in REQ-2.
Clarify the expected behavior after account deletion in REQ-5.
Clarify the expected behavior when clicking the "go elsewhere" link while not signed in in REQ-6.
